scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve Cassian’s place in the June 13 roving-course practice by ensuring its required field-lane orientation is valid beforehand.
Emerging Need: Club notices introduce a prerequisite tied to the future session, while Cassian’s own archived profile record is needed to determine whether he already satisfies it.
Decision Context: The available makeup slots are limited by a work-calendar conflict and a roster cutoff, so the feasible option narrows before the practice day.
Consequence: If the prerequisite is not handled before the roster closes, the future practice remains on his calendar but he cannot meet the entry condition in time.

parameter.subject: Roving-course practice lottery opens for June 13
parameter.body: Saturday June 13 roving-course practice lottery entries are open until Monday, June 8 at 09:00. Only archers with current Hawthorne field-lane orientation may shoot the roving course. Makeup orientations are Thursday, June 11 at 18:30 and Friday, June 12 at 12:15; roster requests must reach Mara by Tuesday, June 9 at 12:00.

parameter.title: Worksite lunch coverage
parameter.description: Imported shift coverage during the Friday lunch period.

parameter.subject: June 13 roving practice slot offered
parameter.body: Your lottery entry cleared for the Saturday, June 13 roving-course practice at Powell Butte Field. Please release the slot by Tuesday at 15:00 if you cannot attend. Field-lane orientation status will be checked against the makeup roster before Saturday check-in packets are printed.

parameter.content: Heads-up for roving-course folks: I am finalizing the same-week orientation roster tomorrow at noon. Thursday evening still has seats; Friday lunch is nearly full. Once the roster goes to the parks office, I cannot add same-week names.
The field-lane orientation roster just went to the parks office. I cannot add anyone else for this week, and there are no walk-on orientation checks before Saturday's roving practice.
